fixtureEvidence.note: No rule fixtures exist. intendedEvidencePacketAssociation names Gate 0 evidence packets that carry no rule-outcome evidence; it records an intended future association and is not fixture coverage.

axisSeparation.note: Three distinct measures never combined: 0 human-required source obligations (all 4 human-required parts are evaluation preconditions); 22 governed rule definitions; 12 finding-capable designs.

claimBoundaries: An intended evidence-packet association is not fixture coverage.
A defined evaluator mechanism is not an implemented evaluator.
A proxy result is not proof of the source obligation it stands in for.
Operationally permitted does not mean formally accepted.
A validator pass establishes structural conformance only; semantic completeness requires owner review.
A proxy or precondition result is not obligation compliance and is not a product finding.

sourceObligationCoverage.note: Executable-rule coverage of source obligations is 12. Total source-obligation coverage is 21 = 12 rules + 0 human-required + 9 unresolved.

findingPolicyAccounting.outputsQualifyingAsFindings: Only obligation_satisfied and obligation_violation from the 12 source-obligation rules. condition_not_met is a diagnostic activation result, not a normative conclusion; indeterminate, evaluator_error, proxy and precondition results are likewise not findings.
findingPolicyAccounting.note: 22 pilot rule designs; 12 normative; 10 diagnostic-only; 0 implemented evaluators; 0 generated findings. Applicability of the existing review policy to future pilot-rule findings remains unresolved pending pre-Gate 2B remediation.

deferredRemediation.mismatch: Gate 1 phase1-behavior-coverage.json sets humanReviewRequired: true on all 87 source statements. That policy is expressed per statement, whereas findings are produced per rule, and 10 of 20 rule designs structurally cannot produce a finding at all.
deferredRemediation.resolution: Restate the review policy in terms of findings produced by normative rules rather than in terms of source statements.

statementDecompositionVsCoverage.note: Decomposition and coverage are governed independently. decompositionStatus records whether every identified normative obligation of a statement is REPRESENTED by a part. Coverage records whether a represented obligation has an approved enforcement mechanism. A statement can be fully decomposed and simultaneously carry unresolved obligations; neither implies the other and the counts are never summed. Decomposition claims are marked unconfirmed-pending-owner-review because no validator can establish semantic completeness.

humanRequiredBreakdown.note: All 4 human-required parts are evaluation preconditions supplying conditional inputs. No source obligation carries a human-required disposition: every frozen fragment that reads as a condition has been classified as evaluator input rather than as an obligation.
